form.label: Alert History
form.description: Executions and triggers of the "Index not receiving data" alert, and per-index silence episodes reconstructed from the status snapshots.

panel.title: Silence episodes per index (snapshots with status STALE)

search.query: index=summary sourcetype=idxmon_status status=STALE | stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen max(minutes_since) as max_silent_min latest(severity) as severity by index | eval duration=tostring(last_seen-first_seen,"duration"), still_stale=if(last_seen>=relative_time(now(),"-20m"),"yes","no"), first_seen=strftime(first_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), max_silent=tostring(max_silent_min*60,"duration") | sort - still_stale, - max_silent_min | table index severity first_seen last_seen duration max_silent still_stale | rename index as Index, severity as Severity, first_seen as "First seen stale", last_seen as "Last seen stale", duration as "Observed duration", max_silent as "Max silence", still_stale as "Still stale"
index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler savedsearch_name="IDX Monitor - Alert - Index not receiving data" | timechart span=1h count by status
index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler savedsearch_name="IDX Monitor - Alert - Index not receiving data" result_count>0 | table _time result_count alert_actions status | sort - _time
